T: Watch out for that tree. And the snacks.
D: A good-hearted jungle man raised by apes falls for an heiress and follows her to San Francisco.
P: Serve the snacks when George swings straight into a tree.
S: Ripe bananas mashed with brown sugar, butter, egg and cinnamon, baked in a loaf tin at 175C for 55 minutes, sliced thick and buttered. Mash 3 ripe bananas with 150g brown sugar, 100g melted butter, 2 eggs and a teaspoon of cinnamon. Fold in 250g self-raising flour until just combined. Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55 minutes. Cool a little, then slice thick and butter.
Shep the elephant who thinks he's a dog

Roasted peanuts set in a golden honey toffee with a pinch of chilli and sea salt, cooled hard and smashed into shards for snacking. Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar, 80g honey and 60ml water until it turns light amber, about 8 minutes. Stir in 250g roasted peanuts, 20g butter, half a tsp chilli flakes and half a tsp bicarb soda, then pour straight onto the tray and spread thin. Sprinkle with sea salt and cool for 30 minutes. Smash into shards.
Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit in a big bowl with lime juice and torn mint.
M: Ape, the talking gorilla with very good manners

Eye fillet seared and roasted to medium rare, sliced with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, crisp potato rösti and garlicky green beans. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze dry, season and fry as 4 rösti in butter for 6 minutes a side. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks and roast at 200C to 54C inside, then rest. Reduce 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a chopped eschalot and tarragon to 1 tbsp. Whisk with 2 egg yolks over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with garlic.
San Francisco cioppino with garlic toast

Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, fennel and garlic broth with a pinch of chilli, served with garlicky toasted sourdough for mopping. Soften a sliced fennel bulb, an onion and 3 garlic cloves in olive oil. Add a pinch of chilli flakes, a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 400g chunks of white fish, 300g green prawns and 500g mussels, cover and cook 6 minutes until the mussels open. Stir through parsley. Toast sourdough slices, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.
W: the trees George keeps swinging into

Coconut rice pudding simmered 30 minutes with sugar and vanilla, chilled, topped with toasted coconut and mango. Simmer 150g arborio rice in 800ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla paste for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Chill for 2 hours. Spoon into bowls and top with toasted shredded coconut and slices of fresh mango.
K: the elephant who thinks he's a dog

Banana, mango, yoghurt and honey blended with ice until thick, poured into tall glasses. Peel 2 bananas and a mango and drop into a blender. Add 300g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and a big handful of ice. Blend until thick and smooth, adding a splash of water if it is too thick, then pour into tall glasses with straws.

Peel and cube 2 mangoes, half a pineapple and half a papaya and tip into a big bowl. Scoop over the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Squeeze over the juice of 2 limes and toss gently with torn mint leaves. Chill for 20 minutes before serving.
